name: birthday
description: A player's birthday is an IN-WORLD date: the account's registration timestamp extrapolated onto the world calendar (real days elapsed × the game clock's speed), then twenty-five years back — the age the vats hand you. It is latched into a player flag the first time it is asked for, because the speed knob moves and a recomputed birthday would move with it. `birthday` is the only surface that tells you yours, and on the day itself it hands over a free MANY HAPPY RETURNS soylent pouch, once per game year.
